title: Chauri Chaura Incident 5th Feb 1922
definition: A violent confrontation in the Gorakhpur district of United Provinces where a mob of protesters set fire to a police station, leading to the death of 22-23 policemen, which served as the immediate catalyst for Gandhi's withdrawal of the Non-Cooperation Movement.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the critical turning point in the Gandhian phase of the freedom struggle, testing the candidate's understanding of non-violence (Ahimsa) vs. mass mobilization, and the internal ideological rift within the Congress (Pro-changers vs. No-changers).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Chauri Chaura Incident 5th Feb 1922.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
